method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:40 AM EAT on 13 sources (12 answered; ReliefWeb failed again) pulled 2,021 postings. 1,541 were older than 7 days or old reposts, 193 senior or excluded titles, 133 not target roles, 33 excluded Kenya, 44 duplicates and 1 already applied. Most of the 76 that passed were bump-dated reposts or roles shown before. micro1's own portal was read directly: 28 posts are new since yesterday. The two that touch software or AI lead the list; the rest need specialist backgrounds (intelligence, law, inspection, military) or are U.S.-only, and are listed as set aside. Jobgether answered live over HTTP (418 offers, 240 from the last 7 days); the only worldwide-open new ones need German or Spanish, so none made the list. A Supabase role that looked fresh on Jobicy was really posted on 2 September. Nothing old was carried over.

stories.title: xAI is buying out Mississippi homeowners who promise not to sue over data center noise
stories.summary: A subsidiary of Elon Musk's xAI is offering to buy homes near its Southaven power plant if owners release their claims in a noise lawsuit; a realtor reportedly said it aims for 418 homes.
stories.why: The biggest xAI story this week, and a sign of how hard the AI power buildout is pressing on neighbours.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a big jump in cybersecurity
stories.summary: Google's new frontier model tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, with gains in coding and agentic tasks.
stories.why: The model race moves fast; worth knowing the current leaders before AI interviews.

stories.title: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a free open-weight speech model
stories.summary: It transcribes audio in up to 40 languages, handles hour-long recordings and tells up to eight speakers apart; Nvidia also released version 2 of its Granary speech dataset.
stories.why: Open voice models make transcription features cheap to build, including for Swahili-speaking users.

stories.title: Anthropic launches tools to show companies what their AI spending buys
stories.summary: New reporting tools break down the value teams get from token spend, as Anthropic's investor figures show 900% net revenue retention and a Q2 operating profit.
stories.why: Measuring AI value is becoming its own product area for engineers.

stories.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI last quarter
stories.summary: A filing shows OpenAI deals brought in nearly 11% of Microsoft's $92.3 billion quarterly revenue, and $24.1 billion over fiscal 2026.
stories.why: Shows how much money is still tied up between the biggest AI players.

stories.title: Upwind raises $400M at a $3.8B valuation after turning down Datadog
stories.summary: The AI cloud-security startup's Series C was led by Bessemer, nine months after a $250 million round at $1.5 billion.
stories.why: Another large AI-security round; security engineering keeps attracting money and hires.

stories.title: Anthropic's public benefit structure adds a wrinkle for IPO investors
stories.summary: Anthropic aims to list at $1.5 trillion or more, and as a public benefit corporation it must balance its mission with standard duties to shareholders.
stories.why: The Anthropic IPO remains the defining AI listing of the year.

stories.title: Madica gets another $6M from Flourish Ventures for African startups
stories.summary: The extra money extends Madica's investment pilot by three years to back 25 to 30 more early-stage companies; it has funded 18 startups in 10 African countries.
stories.why: More pre-seed money for African founders means more early-stage engineering jobs.

stories.title: Safaricom fired 118 staff over fraud and sent 14 cases to the police
stories.summary: Its FY2026 Sustainable Business Report shows 118 fraud cases investigated and 118 dismissals, up from 113, but no breakdown of what the fraud involved.
stories.why: Fraud and trust are a big focus at Kenya's largest tech employer.

stories.title: M-PESA wealth management reaches KSh21.1 billion in assets
stories.summary: Safaricom reported 2.2 million active customers on the service in the year to 31 March 2026.
stories.why: M-PESA keeps moving past payments into savings and investing, where fintech engineering work is growing.

stories.title: Safaricom joins Jamii's legal fight over Kenya's revised spectrum fees
stories.summary: The High Court let Safaricom into Jamii's challenge to the Communications Authority's band-based spectrum charges, which have been suspended since April 2025.
stories.why: The outcome shapes what Kenyan operators pay for mobile data capacity.

stories.title: FirstRand renews its search for a Kenyan bank
stories.summary: South Africa's FirstRand is hunting for a smaller Kenyan lender to buy, after earlier talks failed on price, as Kenyan bank profits rose 16.3% to KSh241.65 billion.
stories.why: More regional banks entering Kenya can mean more local fintech and banking tech roles.
